page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top, page number at top right. Two round coin portraits with legends above the text. Running text below in one column. Signature at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: FRIDERICVS, huius nominis primus, natione Sueuus, cognomento Aenobarbus, à colore barbæ ruffæ, nepos Conradi ex fratre, post eundem Conradum tertium Romæ imperat anno mundi 5114. à Christo nato 1152. Hic Dertonam (nunc Tortonam vocant) portas sibi claudere ausam, obsessam capit: inde Romam contendens ab Adriano coronatur. Euersa Dertona quæ in partibus Alexandri stabat, in cuius locum Octauianum Pontificem crearat, Mediolanum inde solo æquat: Galliámque omnem Cisalpinam eadem sentientem vastat: tertiò & quartò Italiam intrans Alexandrum fugat. Tandem Friderici filio, nauali prælio victo, utitur Fridericus summa humilitate: nam pro templi foribus humi prostratus ante Pontificem, pedibus eius se opprimi permittit. Pontifex clamari præcipit, Super aspidem & basiliscum ambulabis, & conculcabis leonem, & draconem, ac tum eum absoluit. Fridericus eam à se exhiberi humilitatem Petro, non Alexandro, dixit: respondit Alexander, & mihi & Petro. Hic deinde Saracenos ac Turcas prostrauit, Sultanum in Aegyptum fugauit: verùm capta iam Armenia, cùm in equo rapidum amnem ingreditur, strenuissimus heros perit, anno imperij 37. Egna.lib.3.

HENRICVS Friderici filius post patrem imperat anno mundi 5151. à Christo nato 1189. huic Papa Clemens tertius Constantiam virginem sacram, Rogerij Normani filiam, vxorem dedit. Siciliam obtinuit, Tancredo spurio expugnato. Philippum fratrem, qui postea imperat, cum exercitu in Syriam misit: ducibus etiam Archiepiscopo Maguntino, & Saxoniæ Duce existentibus. Aemy. lib. 6. Blond. lib. 6. Egna. lib. 3. imperat ann. 10.

page.notes: Two round coin portraits with legends: left "IMP CAES FRIDERICVS AVG", right "IMP HENRICHVS VI AVG". Legends transcribed as lines. The first medallion's legend is curved, so the reading of the wording is firm but the arrangement around the coin is approximate. Long s is written as plain s. Printed "vtitur" and "vxorem" are given as "utitur" and "vxorem" per the u/v rule. Printed spelling otherwise kept.
